label: Grid Cull -- a crowd culled to a shortlist
description: The needle out of the haystack: a dense wall of small record cards (people, leads, accounts) lands in a wave, the matches ring in the accent one by one, everyone else blurs away, and the survivors glide into a ranked column under a title chip. Use it for 'out of hundreds, these five' beats -- audience segmentation, lead scoring, candidate matching. The crowd is seeded (fake, deterministic); only the survivors need real rows. Size it with its box; it fits 16x9, 9x16 and 4x5. Anchors: grid, card (every card), avatar, shortlist.

rows.label: Real rows: [{name, role, avatar (image URL, optional), score ('96% match', optional), keep: true for a survivor}]. Survivors are the rows marked keep (else the first five); up to 8.

score.label: Badge shown in the shortlist ('Top 5%', '96% match')

count.label: How many cards in the crowd (default 96, max 320)

column_title.label: The chip over the shortlist ('Your JD -- Creative strategist')

column.label: Where the shortlist lands: center (default) | left | right

crowd_roles.label: Second lines for the seeded crowd (default: marketing roles)

at.label: When the wave starts (scene seconds, default 0.2)

scan_at.label: When the matches ring (default: the wave's end)

gather_at.label: When the survivors glide into the column
